name: View-Dependent Transparency
aliases: View-Dependent Transparency — Image fading with incidence angle
definition: A compositing technique where transparency is adjusted based on the viewer's angle, cited as [BG07] (Bruckner and Gröller, 2007).
summary: View-Dependent Transparency modulates opacity based on the angle between surface normals and the viewer to reduce visual clutter and improve shape perception, unlike standard volume rendering.
